chapter: The Original Dixieland band to California
title: San Francisco's musicians in 1926
summary: Joe and Barry recall Clem Raymond, Wade Whaley, Amos White, Frank Goody and pianists around Oakland and San Francisco.

people.name: Frank (with Buddy Petit and Wade Whaley)

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When you went to San Francisco, was the Barbary Coast still operating and all of that kind of stuff, or...
No, no it wasn't, unh-uh. Not in '26. It might have been, but I didn't know anything about it. During that time, Clem Raymond was around there, a clarinet player, Wade Whaley...
In Los Angeles or San Francisco?
San Francisco.
I remember Clem was up there. And was Amos White up there? Had he come up there then?
I think so. I believe so, come to think about it. What other musicians of good...
Frank Goody, was he up there, another clarinet player?
I think Frank Goody had left and gone to Europe.
Oh yeah, he did go on some funny trip like that. That's right.
He stayed in Europe a long time. I seen him when he come back. I met him up there.
Darensbourg - 133

I know Amos White had gone up there after... He'd played with Fate Marable around there. When did they make those records with Fate? That was around '26 or '27. And Amos had gone up there, to Oakland. He still lives up there... Is he still living, Amos? I think he is, isn't he?
Could be. I don't know.
I saw him up there ten years ago, seven years ago. Was there any New Orleans bands operating up there when you went up there? You said you saw Clem Raymond. Did he have a band up there?
Yeah, he had a little band. So did Wade. But I can't remember who was in it?
Let me see. Buddy Petit, Wade and Frank(?) came out here to join Jelly Roll at this...oh, I can't remember the name of the place right now. Then they went back to New Orleans.
Yeah.
But then they must have come out again, if you say...

I'm trying to think of the name... I know the club you're talking about. But I can't think of it. Ory played in there. But Clem and them was playing around over there. And this guy Branco(?), this good piano player I was telling you about out of Baton Rouge, he had a band,
Darensbourg - 134

too. I don't know if he had anybody in that band from New Orleans. But I couldn't remember... They had a guy named Fess Duncan; Duncan Fess, they called him -- he was from New Orleans. Pretty good piano player.
